title: The Border Post — EN/SN/ES (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Spanish heritage diaspora migration
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The border post between the life you had and the life you're going to
Is not always a building with a stamp and something to go through
Sometimes it's a flight, a morning, a decision made at dawn
Sometimes it's a conversation after which the old has gone

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Muganhu une zita asi hauna musuwo
[The border has a name but not always a door]
Dzimwe nguva imuganhu uri mumwoyo wako
[Sometimes the border is inside your own heart]
Waenda reMhiri, asi wanga uchichema
[You went abroad, but you were still weeping]
Muganhu wakadzidzisa kuti kuenda hakuregeri
[The border taught that going away does not forget]

[Chorus — English]
The border post, the border post
Standing between two countries and two kinds of belonging
The border post, the border post
The stamp on the page says yes but something's still ongoing
The border post knows you're carrying more than what's declared
The border post knows what's in the bag that you prepared

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
El puesto fronterizo sabe lo que llevas contigo
[The border post knows what you carry with you]
Más que ropa y fotos — llevas a todo tu abrigo
[More than clothes and photos — you carry your whole shelter]
El oficial pregunta el propósito de tu visita aquí
[The official asks the purpose of your visit here]
Y el propósito es una vida entera — eso no cabe en el papel
[And the purpose is a whole life — that doesn't fit in the form]

[Outro — All three languages]
Border post knows… Muganhu unoziva… El puesto fronterizo sabe
Two countries, one person — Nyika mbiri, munhu mumwe — Dos países, una persona
The gardens still growing
